$meta.description: Every CLI screen that should have a pattern. The lint compares this against design-system/patterns/ and reports gaps. Uncovered screens become NEEDS PATTERN items on the Figma Mirror page.

screens.notes: Leaf command help with summary, flags, examples
Success close with ✓ rows and WHAT TO DO NEXT
Full error template: WHAT WENT WRONG + TRY + MOD FAILED
Inline error: ! Error + Did you mean + Available commands
In-flight progress bar with action headers
⚠ count line + recovery prose + MOD PARTIALLY SUCCEEDED
List/table output with optional row glyphs
Session start frame: /// MODERNE + info rows + prompt
Numbered setup ladder reusable beyond top-level help

screens.command: mod config http trust-store edit file <path>

screens.notes: Login/auth success — similar to config-confirmation but for auth flow
Auth-specific error — may use error pattern or need its own treatment for browser handoff failures
Multi-repo operation: per-repo status rows (✓/⚠/✗) + aggregate summary. May be a variant of success or its own pattern.
Interactive prompt — extrapolated in gaps.md A-4 but no pattern file exists. Yellow ? glyph, [Y/n] convention.
Recipe study output — likely a specialized list/table variant with per-repo change details
Run history — time-ordered list of past runs with status. Likely a list pattern variant.
